items.description: Noah Kahan Essentials captures the introspective songwriting that made him a breakout voice in modern folk. Blending raw emotion with anthemic choruses, his music turns personal reflection into something universally felt. (Photo: Mercury/Press)

items.description: Whether you're having a stroll in the park on a rainy day, or spending the day indoors, this selection of laidback pop songs might be what you need as your autumn soundtrack. (Photo: Roman Kraft/Unsplash)
